footer.about: Arasya Rentcar delivers chauffeur car rental with professional drivers for business trips, family travel, and airport transfers across Indonesia.
footer.antiFraudNotice: Arasya Rentcar bookings are confirmed only via the single official admin WhatsApp number shown on this website. Any other number claiming to be Arasya Rentcar is not our official channel. Always verify with the official admin before transferring funds to any personal account.

hero.headline: Trusted chauffeur car rental with professional drivers
hero.subheadline: Business trips, family holidays, and airport transfers feel effortless with experienced chauffeurs and a maintained fleet from Arasya Rentcar.

trustSignals.heading: Experienced Professional Chauffeurs
trustSignals.description: Every chauffeur passes strict screening, ongoing training, and knows major city routes and guest service etiquette by heart.

trustSignals.heading: Verified Rental Vehicles
trustSignals.description: Each car is routinely inspected, actively insured, and prepared for short city trips as well as longer intercity journeys.

trustSignals.heading: Transparent Pricing Upfront
trustSignals.description: Quoted rates already include the chauffeur, basic fuel, and a clear breakdown from the start with no hidden charges.

trustSignals.heading: Direct WhatsApp Support
trustSignals.description: The official Arasya Rentcar admin is ready to assist bookings, schedule changes, and service questions on WhatsApp with fast responses.
